dict.Patru panouri: aceeași foaie în patru pă: Four panes: the same sheet in four parts; the top ones scroll down together, the left ones scroll right together (for example the table header and the first column stay in view wherever you go). Click again = Remove split
dict.Dreapta jos: rândurile din stânga jos și: Bottom right: the rows of the bottom left and the columns of the top right; click a cell = type in it here, double-click = select it in the sheet
dict.Dreapta sus: aceleași rânduri ca foaia d: Top right: the same rows as the sheet on the left, other columns; click a cell = type in it here, double-click = select it in the sheet
dict.Stânga jos: aceleași coloane ca foaia de: Bottom left: the same columns as the sheet above, other rows; click a cell = type in it here, double-click = select it above
